customer_id.meaning: primary id of the account profile (content hash)

customer_type.meaning: whether this profile is a client organisation's billing account or an individual employee diner

full_name.meaning: name on file: the authorised contact's name for a client organisation profile, the employee's name for an employee profile

organization_name.meaning: registered name of the client organisation; empty on an employee profile

phone_number.meaning: the direct telephone number on file, used as an identity credential

email_address.meaning: the work email address on file, used as an identity credential

employee_badge_number.meaning: badge number printed on the employee's site badge; empty on a client organisation profile

client_account_code.meaning: client account code of the organisation this profile bills under; on an employee profile it is the employer's code

site_code.meaning: the workplace site this profile is primarily attached to

department_name.meaning: department or cost centre named on the profile; empty when none is recorded

billing_zip_code.meaning: postal code of the billing address on file, used as an identity credential

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the profile was first opened, used as an identity credential

cafe_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the workplace cafe management contract

customer_id.meaning: client organisation holding the contract (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the service model held, written as the official full tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

site_code.meaning: the workplace site whose cafe this contract operates

contract_start_date.meaning: first day of the contract term as signed

contract_end_date.meaning: last day of the current contract term

service_commenced_date.meaning: day the cafe first opened to employees; empty while the contract is still proposed or mobilizing

suspension_start_date.meaning: first day of the current service suspension; empty when service is not suspended

termination_notice_date.meaning: day the client gave written notice of termination; empty while no notice has been given

closed_date.meaning: day the contract closed; empty while it is still open

subsidy_pool_balance_usd.meaning: current unspent client meal-subsidy funding; identically the sum of the subsidy_pool account deltas

receivable_balance_usd.meaning: current amount invoiced and not yet settled; identically the sum of the receivable account deltas

headcount_served.meaning: badged employee headcount the site reports for this cafe

invoice_cycle_day.meaning: day of each month on which this contract is invoiced

billing_contact_email.meaning: email address invoices for this contract are sent to

purchase_order_reference.meaning: the client's purchase order reference to quote on invoices; empty when the client does not use one

suspension_days_used_ytd.meaning: calendar days of suspension already taken in the current contract year

service_model_change_effective_date.meaning: day the most recent service model change took effect; empty when the model has never changed

cafe_ledger_id.meaning: primary id of the cafe ledger row

cafe_contract_id.meaning: cafe contract the posting belongs to (foreign key -> cafe_contracts)

customer_id.meaning: client organisation the posting belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the cafe charter

charge_code.meaning: the billing subtype of this posting; it is what separates two postings that differ only in why the money moved

amount_usd.meaning: amount of the posting, always recorded as a positive magnitude; the direction is carried by the event family

posted_date.meaning: day the posting was booked to the contract

service_period.meaning: billing period the posting relates to; for a payment it is the period of the invoice being settled

invoice_reference.meaning: the invoice this posting is or settles; empty on postings that belong to no invoice

funding_lot_reference.meaning: the subsidy funding lot credited or drawn against; empty on postings that touch no funding lot

source_reference.format: the reference of the originating record, as printed on that record
source_reference.meaning: the single record that caused this posting, such as the employee meal transaction behind a subsidy drawdown; empty when the posting originates on the contract itself

meal_period.meaning: meal period the posting relates to; not_applicable on postings that are not meal-period specific

payment_channel.meaning: how money moved on this posting; not_applicable where no money changed hands

cafe_service_request_id.meaning: primary id of the cafe service request record

customer_id.meaning: client organisation raising the request (foreign key -> customers)

cafe_contract_id.meaning: cafe contract the request concerns (foreign key -> cafe_contracts)

request_type.meaning: what the client is asking for

request_status.meaning: where the request has got to; received is the state a newly logged request lands in

requested_effective_date.meaning: day the client wants the change to take effect

requested_variant_name.meaning: service model the client wants to move to; empty on requests that are not a service model change

related_reference.format: the reference printed on the record the request concerns
related_reference.meaning: the invoice or billing period the request concerns; empty when the request concerns the contract as a whole

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
